column4: Imposes carbon costs on imports. Helps climate goals but raises prices and trade friction.
Forces large-scale electricity storage. Expensive resilience against blackouts.
Subsidises deep building renovations. Slow climate and housing-quality gains at high fiscal cost.
Caps rent growth. Popular with tenants; deters housing investment.
Mass public housebuilding. Heavy budget cost; slow relief for homelessness.
Regulates automated layoffs. Softens backlash; slows tech adoption.
State compute infrastructure. Long-run tech capacity; serious budget pressure.
Holds platforms liable for harms. Trust gains; business and tech friction.
Funds rapid asylum processing capacity. Costly; reduces border-crisis severity.
Fast-track visas for scarce skills. Growth upside; migration politics heat up.
Legal maximum waits for key surgeries. Popular and expensive.
Mandatory medical stockpiles. Ongoing cost; dampens health crises.
